title: Really good app with one problem
body:
Habitica is really useful and efficient. it actually helps you stick to habits because it turns progress into something you can see and feel. I love how motivating and rewarding it is when I complete my tasks.

The only issue is that my character’s level drops by about one every day, and the health depletion feels like a lot. It might just be a me thing but like It makes it harder to bounce back on busy days.
If the health depletion was lower and there was a “second chance” to help you level back up, it would be even better. Still, it’s definitely worth 5 stars.

title: Would like a Join Party function
body:
I would like there to be an option to start or join parties. Especially for people who are introverts/socially anxious and maybe don’t have the option to invite IRL friends.

In general, this app is very accessible and I loved that there was a wheelchair option for the avatar.

title: Awesome
body:
